[IDSP.14.6] **No separate registration step.**
`ds_dispatch_t` is not a plugin table.  All eight
functions are first-party dispatcher entry points that
exist unconditionally.  Integrators do not add to or
replace entries in `ds_dispatch_t`; integrator callbacks
are wired through the existing per-verb callback tables
(IDSP.5–9), which the dispatcher entry points call into.
